title: INCOLOR VOYAGER positioning recheck
notes: Exact VOYAGER page says it is built for multi-terrain riding (为多地形骑行而生), that INCOLOR wants its gravel bike to be highly versatile, that it performs well on gravel and paved roads, and that its geometry combines road-bike responsiveness with gravel stability. It fits 45C knobby tires with a 50T single or 52/36T double crankset; no racing wording appears.
